name: aicore
description: AICore repository workspace. Each CLI application under cli/ owns its own source, tests and package configuration.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm --dir mcp-servers/system-one typecheck && pnpm --dir .opencode/plugins/odd-adviser typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm -r test && pnpm --dir mcp-servers/system-one test && pnpm --dir .opencode/plugins/odd-adviser test && pnpm test:cli:e2e
